ref_file_title: Val08 - Incrementally Verifiable Computation or Proofs of Knowledge Imply Time-Space Efficiency
note: Exact title uses a slash ('Time/Space'); removed in the filename. Verified against vendor/cryptobib TCC:Valiant08 (LNCS 4948, pp. 1-18, DOI 10.1007/978-3-540-78524-8_1) and web-search snippets (Springer/IACR hosts blocked). Introduces IVC as a composable proof system: two proofs of length k merge into a proof of the conjunction of length k; built on CS proofs of knowledge. TCC 2019 Test-of-Time award. cryptobib_key: TCC:Valiant08.

ref_file_title: Ver92 - On the Power of PP
note: Proc. 7th Annual Structure in Complexity Theory Conference, IEEE, 1992, pp. 138-143. Proves MA ⊆ PP and gives an oracle relative to which AM ⊄ PP. Not in cryptobib; needs inline bibtex.

ref_file_title: Vya03 - QMA=PP implies that PP contains PH
note: Proves the stronger QMA ⊆ A0PP ⊆ PP; per the Vidick–Watrous survey this is the first written proof of the containment (KW00 state it without proof). Confirmed only via ECCC search-result snippet (title, author, report number, abstract); eccc.weizmann.ac.il is blocked. Not in cryptobib; inline bibtex.

ref_file_title: WW24 - Adaptively-Sound Succinct Arguments for NP from Indistinguishability Obfuscation
note: cryptobib STOC:WatWu24 (STOC 2024, pp. 387-398, DOI 10.1145/3618260.3649671); ePrint 2024/165. Abstract verified via search snippet: first adaptively-sound SNARG for NP in the plain model from sub-exponentially-hard iO, sub-exponentially-hard one-way functions, and polynomial hardness of discrete log or factoring; the abstract reads GW11 as requiring 'sub-exponential hardness (and complexity leveraging)'.

ref_file_title: Wat02 - Limits on the Power of Quantum Statistical Zero-Knowledge
note: Verified in vendor/cryptobib/crypto.bib as FOCS:Watrous02 (pp. 459-470, doi 10.1109/SFCS.2002.1181970). NB cryptobib's title field has a typo ('imits on the Power...'); the reference page must use the correct title. Preprint arXiv:quant-ph/0202111, 'Quantum statistical zero-knowledge'. Abstract (search snippets): defines honest-verifier QSZK, proves the quantum state distinguishability problem complete for it, closure under complement, two-message parallelization, and containment in PSPACE.

Verified in vendor/cryptobib/crypto.bib as STOC:Watrous06 (pp. 296-305, doi 10.1145/1132516.1132560); preprint arXiv:quant-ph/0511020; journal version SIAM J. Comput. 39(1):25-58, 2009. The key Wat09 is NOT usable: content/References/Wat09 - Dual System Encryption... is Waters 2009. Abstract (search snippets): quantum rewinding; 'establishes that honest verifier and general quantum statistical zero-knowledge are equal: QSZK = HVQSZK'.

ref_file_title: Wee24 - Circuit ABE with poly(depth, lambda)-Sized Ciphertexts and Keys from Lattices
note: cryptobib key C:Wee24 (title, author, pages 178-209, CRYPTO 2024 Part III, LNCS 14922, DOI verified in vendor/cryptobib/crypto.bib; Springer/eprint 2024/1416 records confirmed via search snippets). Prior work, not a follow-up: role 'improvement' only because the schema has no 'prior' role. Introduces the l-succinct LWE assumption; abstract: 'a falsifiable assumption which is implied by evasive LWE'. Needed as the origin of the assumption and as the source for the evasive-LWE => succinct-LWE edge.

ref_file_title: Yao82a - Theory and Applications of Trapdoor Functions
